meditation.text: Let's take this time just for you.
Find a position you can hold with ease, and when you are ready, let your eyes close.
There is nothing to fix here, and nowhere else to be.
Begin to notice the breath, just as it is.
You do not need to change it. Simply follow it.
Feel the cool air as it enters, and the warm air as it leaves.
Feel the weight of your body, held by the chair or the floor.
When the mind wanders, and it will, that is not a mistake.
Gently notice where it went, and come back to the breath.
Each time you return is the practice.
Rest here, with nothing to do but breathe.
In a moment, we will close.
Let the breath find its own rhythm again.
And whenever you are ready, {name}, let your eyes open.

sleep.text: The day is finished. There is nothing left to do.
Let your body sink into the bed, and let it hold your weight.
Take one slow breath in, and a long breath out.
Soften your face. Let the jaw be loose.
Let the shoulders drop, and grow heavy.
Feel your arms, and your hands, giving their weight to the bed.
And your legs, heavy, and still.
Nothing to hold. Nothing to carry.
Each breath out, a little heavier.
It is alright to drift. You do not need to stay with my voice.
Let the thoughts come and go, like distant traffic.
There is nowhere to be but here, and here is soft.

flow.text: Alright, {name}. Let's get ready to begin.
Sit tall, and let your shoulders settle.
Take a slow breath in, and let it go.
Let the noise of the day begin to settle, like sediment sinking in still water.
One more breath, deeper this time.
As you breathe out, let the clutter go with it.
The water is clearing. The mind is settling.
Bring to mind the one thing you are here to do.
Hold it simply, without pressure. Just a clear intention.
Calm, and awake. Relaxed, and sharp.
Let your attention gather to a single point.
And when you are ready, {name}, open your eyes, and begin.

relax.text: Welcome, {name}. Let's take a moment to unwind.
Settle in, and let yourself arrive.
Breathing in, feel yourself settle. Breathing out, feel yourself ease.
Let the jaw unclench, and the shoulders drop.
There is nothing to chase right now.
This moment, just as it is, is enough.
Feel the breath moving slowly, like a tide.
With each breath out, let a little more tension go.
Warm, and unhurried. Nowhere to be.
Let the whole body soften into ease.
Stay here as long as you like.
And carry a little of this ease with you, {name}, when you return.

stress-relief.text: It's okay, {name}. Let's steady this together.
Feel your feet on the floor, and the seat beneath you.
You are here, and you are safe enough, right now.
Let's lengthen the breath. In, slowly.
And out, longer than the breath in.
And a long, slow breath out.
Notice a few sounds around you, near and far.
You do not have to push the feeling away.
Just let it be here, and let it move through, like weather.
It will pass. It always has.
Meet it with a little kindness, the way you would a friend.
Steadier now. The breath, long and slow.
You've moved through hard moments before, {name}. You can move through this one.
